backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: Saves this profile's library in a .zip file, with its images, documents and settings.
backups.creating: Saving the library, its images and documents…
backups.missing_one: 1 file of the library was not found, so it was not included.
backups.missing_other: {{count}} files of the library were not found, so they were not included.
backups.automaticHint: An automatic backup is saved before a profile is deleted, a backup is restored over it or a library is imported into it. The 10 most recent are kept.

schedule.label: Scheduled backups
schedule.applyToAll: Apply this frequency of scheduled backups to all profiles
schedule.hint: They are saved in the background when the profile is opened, if one is due and something has changed since the last one. The 10 most recent of each profile are kept. Each one includes the images and documents, so they can take up a lot of space.
schedule.none: This profile has no scheduled backups yet.
schedule.failed: The scheduled backup of the profile “{{name}}” could not be saved. Check that there is free space. It will be tried again the next time you open it.

restoreOver.stepBackup: Step 2 of 2: saving a backup of the current state…

exports.title: Export
exports.hint: Saves the data of the library in a file, without images, documents or settings. To save everything, create a backup.
exports.jsonHint: Includes the items, the catalogs and the collections, and also what is in the trash.
exports.csvHint: For spreadsheets. Does not include the trash. If everything opens in a single column, try the other separator.

imports.title: Import
imports.hint: Adds to this profile a library exported to JSON, from this profile or another one, or the items of a CSV file. Only what is missing is added: what already exists is not changed.

csv.hint: With the columns of the export, in English or Spanish and in any order; only “Title” is required. Dates as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
csv.invalid_one: Nothing has been imported: “{{fileName}}” has 1 error. Fix it and try again.
